responsibility: Implements Darwin host hooks for GCC’s precompiled-header machinery. It chooses likely stable virtual-memory addresses for mapping PCH images on Darwin hosts, handles Darwin-specific page-size and VM-layout details across architectures, retries mappings when fixed-address allocation fails, and falls back to manual file reads into anonymous mappings when necessary. This is host-side runtime support for GCC itself, not target code generation for Darwin executables.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the host-darwin pair: it contains the Darwin host-side PCH mapping code using mmap, fixed-address probing, and read fallback, whereas host-darwin.h only declares those hooks and installs them into HOST_HOOKS macros.
